title: GasGas EC 350F Enduro (Performance Edition)
description: Representing KTM's prowess in the Adventure Tourer class, the KTM GasGas EC 350F Enduro (Performance Edition) is delivers all-weather long-haul versatility with long-travel suspension compliance. A 350cc powerplant pumps out 44 HP and 38 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With a commanding 855mm perch delivering excellent ground clearance and expansive sightlines and a comfortable Aggressive Forward Tuck layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
